summary: Round 01 is a genuine repair — all five machine gates flipped to PASS and the templated content, repeated Pip lines and banned paywall verb are all gone — but composition still lags correctness on timeline and the paywall, leaving 3 verified red flags and a 96/100 that a single-model-family jury is not competent to certify.
